entities.name: Winota, Heartbonder
entities.description: A human warrior bonder on Ikoria who lost her right arm and bonded the monster she tried to kill.

events.summary: Winota told Vivien Reid how she lost her right arm trying to kill the monster she ended up bonding with.
events.quote: She told the planeswalker Vivien Reid how she lost her right arm trying to kill the monster that she ended up bonding with.
